body.title: Recovery in South Dakota. All 66 Counties.
paragraphs: Minnehaha, Pennington, Lincoln, and Brown counties generate the highest volume of South Dakota foreclosure surplus cases. South Dakota allows both judicial and non-judicial foreclosure. Judicial foreclosure sheriff sale surplus funds are deposited with the South Dakota circuit court, while non-judicial power of sale surplus is held by the foreclosing trustee until claimed by the former owner.

The South Dakota Unclaimed Property Division, administered by the state Treasurer, holds millions in dormant bank accounts, insurance proceeds, uncashed checks, and other assets belonging to South Dakota residents. As a major trust and banking jurisdiction, South Dakota also holds significant unclaimed financial assets from trust accounts and dissolved corporate entities. RCG searches South Dakota circuit court records, county sheriff sale records, and state unclaimed property databases for every South Dakota client.
body.callout: Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in South Dakota. All recoveries are handled on a pure contingency basis with no upfront cost to the client.
